technology_name: Pathogen Enrichment Method for Accurate Microbiome Sequencing
problem_solved: Overwhelming presence of host DNA masks microbial genetic signatures in metagenomic sequencing, lowering diagnostic sensitivity for low-abundance pathogens and increasing sequencing costs.
description: A novel selective host-genome depletion and pathogen read enrichment method optimized for high-resolution metagenomic sequencing of gut and organ microbiomes (covering bacteria, phages, and viruses). The protocol decreases the ratio of background host genetic material before sequencing, allowing low-abundance pathogens to be detected with higher sensitivity. The method is designed to track microbiome shifts across healthy, diseased, chronic treatment, or altered dietary states without requiring altered sequencing hardware.
applications:
• Clinical molecular diagnostics for complex or low-load viral and bacterial infections

• Commercial metagenomic sequencing preparation kits and reagent manufacturing

• Contract research services for validating nutraceutical and dietary microbiome shifts

• High-throughput public health surveillance and infectious disease epidemiology
